## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Draft releases are only visible to users with write access to releases unit | authorization | release.IsDraft && !canAccessReleaseDraft(ctx) |
| Attachment must belong to the specified release | validation | attach.ReleaseID != releaseID |
| Release must belong to the current repository | validation | release.RepoID != ctx.Repo.Repository.ID |
| File type must be in allowed types list for release attachments | validation | upload.Verify(buf, attach.Name, allowedTypes) returns error |
| API token must have repository write scope to access draft releases | authorization | ctx.Data["IsApiToken"] == true && scope lacks write:repository |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |

| New filename extension not allowed | 422 | validationError | False |

### Error Paths

- **Release not found** → checkReleaseMatchRepo → 404
- **Attachment not found** → EditReleaseAttachment → 404
- **Attachment not in release** → EditReleaseAttachment → 404
- **Forbidden file type for new name** → EditReleaseAttachment → 422
